places_available: 180 places, open (free) access — no numero programmato.
academic_requirements: Italian secondary-school diploma or equivalent foreign qualification (12 years of schooling). No specific subject prerequisites beyond passing the mandatory entry test (see entry_exam_or_test). Personal-preparation gap, if any, is recovered via OFA (Obbligo Formativo Aggiuntivo) rather than blocking enrolment for EU/resident applicants.
language_requirements: English B2 required for admission. Regulation allows conditional matriculation without the certificate if obtained by the end of Year 1 (exam block until then) — but non-EU visa applicants are rejected outright at PICA stage without a listed B2 certificate, so treat B2 as effectively mandatory for that group. MOI (Medium of Instruction) letters and Duolingo are explicitly not accepted anywhere at UNIPG.
entry_exam_or_test: Mandatory entry test — the UNIPG international-students page states: "providing a CEnT-S test, a TOLC-I test or a SAT test is mandatory. APPLICATIONS NOT PROVIDING one of the above-mentioned tests WILL BE IMMEDIATELY REJECTED." The faculty-level admission-test page (ing.unipg.it/en/courses/admission-test) lists specific thresholds for only two of the three: TOLC-I >=14/50 overall with >=7/20 in Maths; CEnT-S (CISIA English-language test, live since Nov 2025: 55 questions, 110 min, EUR 55, valid 1 academic year) >=10/35 with >=5/15 in Maths. SAT is confirmed accepted on the international-students page (department page previously cited SAT >=700/1600, Maths >=350/800, and ACT >=16/36, Maths >=15/36, though these department-level SAT/ACT thresholds are not repeated on the faculty admission-test page — flagged as a minor conflict). Below the threshold, EU/resident students may still enrol with an OFA (additional learning obligation); non-EU visa applicants must pass to be admitted.
nulla_osta_required: Not applicable at bachelor level in the same way as master's programmes (nulla osta is a master's-enrolment mechanism); admission is instead gated by the mandatory entry test.
required_documents: Secondary-school diploma (12 years of schooling) with foreign-qualification documentation
application_deadline_eu: EU/legally-residing applicants: PICA pre-enrolment from 1 July 2026 (no published closing date); SOL enrolment for open-access bachelor/single-cycle closes 20 October 2026.
application_deadline_non_eu: Non-EU visa applicants: PICA call 2026-visa-06, open until 12:00 (noon) on 21 August 2026 — CLOSED as of research date (2026-09-05).
tuition_range: EUR 150-2,200/year via a 17-band ISEE table. Non-EU/foreign-income students use a fixed Flat Tax by home-country UNDP Human Development bracket (Turkey = HIGH HD = EUR 800/year + EUR 16 stamp) or ISEEU Parificato via an affiliated CAF. Declaration window 3 Aug-20 Oct 2026 (late to 1 Mar 2027 with surcharge; missing 28 Feb entirely defaults to the maximum band, ~EUR 2,096).
cimea_requirement: Not specified at programme level; see university-wide study-documents page for CIMEA/blackout-date rules.
double_degree: None found on official pages for this programme.
